name: Microbial Mat
flavor: A carpet of cyanobacteria. Doesn't fight back; barely notices you.

name: Sea Anemone
flavor: Looks AFK. Isn't. The nematocyst proc fires the instant you're in range, and it stacks.

name: Trilobite Grazer
flavor: The durable mid-tier pick. Rolls into a ball and waits you out. Boring? It outlasted nearly everything. Respect the defensive build.

name: Anomalocaris
flavor: S-tier apex of the launch meta. Compound eyes that actually resolve the murk. Holds the pinnacle drop. You are not beating this on day one.

name: Plankton Bloom
flavor: The open water's free lunch. No threat, no scarcity — just throughput gated by how much you can filter.

name: Haikouichthys
flavor: Early chordate, Cambrian. Looks like F-tier filler. Is, in fact, your lineage — the unassuming pick that quietly inherits the entire server. Underrated. Do not bully.

name: Tamisiocaris
flavor: Filter-feeding radiodont, Cambrian. AFK farmer; turns plankton into pure uptime. Splice the filter combs and run the passive income build.

name: Glass Drifter
flavor: Invented, clearly stylized — the fossil record has gaps, and something transparent was hunting in them. Nearly invisible in open water. The stealth meta, mid-column.

name: Archaeocyathid Grove
flavor: The Cambrian reef's structural backbone — early sponge-like filter feeders locked into calcite. Good grazing, mild resistance.

name: Wiwaxia
flavor: Sclerite rows, Cambrian. Unmineralized armor — it yields chitin, not calcite. The defensive build's common splicing target.

name: Ottoia
flavor: Priapulid worm, Cambrian. Ambushes from the sediment. Its eversible proboscis fires faster than it looks. Dangerous for its tier.

name: Reef Lurker
flavor: Invented, clearly stylized — ambush predators worked reef structure long before the fossil record names them. Motionless until it isn't. The reef edge apex.
